H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H3843: a brick (from the whiteness of the clay)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H2710: properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H4692: something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H5550: a military mound, i.e. rampart of besiegers
H4264: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H3733: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out)
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H1270: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
H7023: a wall (as built in a trench)
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H6696: to cramp, i.e. confine (in many applications, literally and figuratively, formative or hostile)
H226: a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H7901: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
H4557: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)
H3967: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H8145: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H2220: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
H2834: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
H5012: to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)
H5688: something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2015: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H2406: wheat, whether the grain or the plant
H3698: spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn)
H3627: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H3978: an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit)
H8255: probably a weight; used as a commercial standard
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H5746: to bake (round cakes on the hearth)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3602: just so, referring to the previous or following context
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5080: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2930: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
H5038: a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol
H2966: prey, i.e. flocks devoured by animals
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H1241: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H4294: a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H2637: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
H8074: to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H251: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
H4743: to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish
